```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(message = TRUE, warning = TRUE)
source("00_setup.R")
library(ggpubr)
library(shadowtext)  # needed to draw the ACMG plot's labels
```

Combines the plots saved by steps 3–5, 7 and 9 into the paper figures.

## Inputs

```{r inputs}
enrich_tag <- paste0("rank", candidate_max_rank, remove_vars,
                     "_no_monogen_old_gene_Exomiser", exomiser_version)

plot_files <- c(
  rank   = file.path(images_dir, paste0("Exomiser_rank_of_target_KS_variants_multiple_runs_comparison", file_suffix, ".RData")),
  violin = file.path(images_dir, paste0("Exomiser_scores_violin_plot", file_suffix, ".RData")),
  acmg   = file.path(images_dir, paste0("Exomiser_ACMG_plot", file_suffix, ".RData")),
  go_dot = file.path(images_dir, paste0("GO_BP_dotplot_", enrich_tag, ".RData")),
  overlap = file.path(images_dir, paste0("Exomiser_gene_level_tests_overlap", file_suffix, ".RData"))
)

missing <- plot_files[!file.exists(plot_files)]
if (length(missing) > 0) stop("Missing plot files:\n", paste(missing, collapse = "\n"))

# Each .RData holds one plot object; return it whatever it is called
load_plot <- function(file) {
  env <- new.env()
  obj <- load(file, envir = env)
  env[[obj[[1]]]]
}

plots <- map(plot_files, load_plot)

# The tiff device does not fail when it cannot overwrite a file (e.g. one open
# in an image viewer), so remove the old figure first and check the new one.
save_figure <- function(plot, name, width, height) {
  file <- file.path(figures_dir, paste0(name, file_suffix, ".tiff"))
  if (file.exists(file) && !file.remove(file)) {
    stop("Cannot replace ", file, " -- is it open in another program?")
  }
  ggsave(file, plot, width = width, height = height, device = "tiff",
         dpi = 700, bg = "white", compression = "lzw")
  if (!file.exists(file)) stop("Figure was not written: ", file)
  message("Written: ", file)
}
```

## Figure 2

A: benchmarking of Exomiser runs, B: score distributions, C: automated ACMG
classification.

```{r figure-2, fig.width = 16, fig.height = 18}
with_margin <- function(p) p + theme(plot.margin = margin(1, 1, 1, 1, "cm"))

top_row <- ggarrange(with_margin(plots$rank), with_margin(plots$violin),
                     labels = c("A", "B"),
                     font.label = list(size = 20),
                     ncol = 2, nrow = 1, align = "hv")

bottom_row <- ggarrange(NULL, with_margin(plots$acmg), NULL,
                        labels = c("", "C", ""),
                        font.label = list(size = 20),
                        ncol = 3, nrow = 1,
                        widths = c(0.5, 1, 0.5))

figure_2 <- ggarrange(top_row, bottom_row, ncol = 1, nrow = 2)

figure_2
save_figure(figure_2, "Figure2", width = 16, height = 18)
```

## Figure 3

A: GO enrichment of the candidate NON-ESTABLISHED genes, B: overlap with
gene-level burden tests.

```{r figure-3, fig.width = 10, fig.height = 20}
figure_3 <- ggarrange(plots$go_dot, plots$overlap,
                      labels = c("A", "B"),
                      font.label = list(size = 25),
                      ncol = 1, nrow = 2, heights = c(2, 1))

figure_3
save_figure(figure_3, "Figure3", width = 10, height = 20)
```
